colors.name: Colors
colors.accent_info: Warm accent for badges and editorial elements. Do not use it for body text on white — the contrast ratio is too low.
colors.cta_info: Do not use this color as a fill anywhere else. A single CTA color is what makes the button findable.

layout.name: Layout
layout.animations_info: Elements fade in gently on scroll. Automatically disabled for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

product_card.name: Product cards
product_card.show_rating_info: Stars appear only when the product actually has reviews (reviews.rating metafield). Stars are never shown without underlying reviews.

cart.name: Cart
cart.free_shipping_info: Only enable this if a free shipping threshold genuinely applies. Turn it off when shipping is always free.
cart.free_shipping_threshold_info: Amount in whole euros, e.g. 50. Must exactly match your Shopify shipping settings.

company.name: Company details
company.intro: These details appear in the footer and on the contact page. Complete, verifiable company details are a legal requirement for a Dutch webshop and one of the strongest trust signals available to you. Do not leave any field empty.
company.phone_info: A visible phone number is the difference between a webshop and a risk. Fill this in as soon as phone support is in place.
company.support_hours_info: For example: Mon–Fri 9:00–17:00. Only promise hours you actually staff.

claims.name: Claims and reviews
claims.warning: Important: leave these fields empty unless you can substantiate the claim. An unsubstantiated claim about customer numbers or delivery time is a misleading commercial practice under Dutch and EU law, and damages your credibility more than an empty space does. All fields below are therefore empty by default.
claims.customer_count_info: For example: 25,000+ customers. Only fill this in if you can evidence the figure from order data.
claims.delivery_info: For example: order before 4pm, delivered tomorrow. Enter the delivery time you actually achieve — not the one you would like to achieve. A missed promise costs more revenue than an honest, longer delivery time.
claims.review_score_info: Enter your actual score, or leave empty. The score is only shown if you enter it here; the theme never invents a figure.
